from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u063/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    objects = {color: [] for color in colors}
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            minr, maxr = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc, maxc = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = [(y-minr, x-minc) for y,x in cells]
            objects[color].append({"shape": shape, "n": len(cells), "area": (maxr-minr+1)*(maxc-minc+1), "height": maxr-minr+1, "width": maxc-minc+1})
    left, right = sorted(colors, key=lambda color: min(x for obj in objects[color] for y,x in [(min(a for a,b in obj["shape"]), min(b for a,b in obj["shape"]))]))
    # Pair components by size, then bounding-box area.
    key = lambda obj: (obj["n"], obj["area"])
    objects[left].sort(key=key)
    objects[right].sort(key=key)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    right_x = max(obj["width"] for obj in objects[left]) + 1
    bottom_height = max(objects[left][1]["height"], objects[right][1]["height"])
    top_bottom = h - 2 - bottom_height
    for rank, (lo, ro) in enumerate(zip(objects[left], objects[right])):
        bottom = top_bottom if rank == 0 else h - 1
        for obj, color, xoff in ((lo, left, 0), (ro, right, right_x)):
            yoff = bottom - obj["height"] + 1
            for y, x in obj["shape"]:
                out[yoff+y][xoff+x] = color
    return out
'''
